name: Mirror Meadow of Twin Skies
description: A vast meadow of perfect mirror‑like grass reflecting two opposite skies — one sunrise, one star‑filled night.
prompt: Expansive meadow where each blade of grass acts as a flawless mirror. The left half reflects a vivid sunrise with warm golds and pinks; the right half reflects a deep night sky glittering with the Milky Way. A solitary figure walks the boundary. Ultra‑wide angle, surreal symmetry, high dynamic range, photorealistic.
caption: Walk between day and night in a single step 🌅🌌 #TwinSkies
